node_8.subject: Iris Chang
node_8.description: This is Iris Chang's plan for Monday February 13: 7:00 am - Wake up and complete morning routine., 8:00 am - Have breakfast while reading a book on psychology., 9:00 am - Attend classes at Oak Hill College, focusing on literature and philosophy., 12:00 pm - Have lunch with classmates, participating in casual conversations about their weekend plans., 1:00 pm - Attend afternoon classes, engaging thoughtfully in discussions., 3:00 pm - Study at the library, working on assignments while reflecting on her observations of the new male student., 5:00 pm - Meet with a study group and discuss upcoming exams, subtly gauging their interest in the new student., 6:00 pm - Enjoy dinner in the cafeteria, overhearing girls flirt with the new male student., 7:00 pm - Head back to the dorm, feeling both excited and nervous about the new dynamics., 8:00 pm - Open her textbook and review the day's notes while considering a way to approach the male student., 9:30 pm - Call Mina to discuss the new student and share thoughts on how they might both take initiative to connect with him., 10:30 pm - Journal about her feelings and the challenges of being in the shadow of her sister, while thinking of how to assert her own identity., 11:00 pm - Wind down and go to bed, contemplating her day..
